name: Mary Sunncliffe
original_name: แมรี่ ซันคลิฟอ์
source: Sunlight is a charming and witty woman who runs the Moonlight Hotel. She has made the hotel very popular with the Moonlight locals and is one of the most liked and respected members of the town.
